title: Persona encounter
description: One session in which a persona met an artifact. Written by the persona before it returns, so the record survives the session that produced it. A persona's continuity lives in these files, never in a live agent process.

persona_id.description: Foreign key into personas.json. The identity lives there, not here.

slug.description: Stable across versions, so encounters can be compared over time

version.description: Commit, build hash, or snapshot name. Required to compare rounds honestly.

frozen.description: True when the artifact was snapshotted so edits could not race the session

project.description: Project or category this artifact belongs to. Lets a persona with recall scope "project" carry context across artifacts in the same ongoing effort.

blind.description: True when the persona was given no prior encounter of its own. Blind reads avoid anchoring; informed reads answer whether something improved. Never mix them silently.

prior_encounters_shown.description: encounter_ids the persona was allowed to read. Empty when blind.

viewports.description: e.g. 390x844, 1440x900. Findings are meaningless without this.

driver.description: How the artifact was operated, e.g. a real browser session

time_budget.description: Stated constraint the persona worked under, e.g. four minutes

verbatim.description: The persona's unedited report. Never summarise here. Synthesis belongs in a separate file so this stays checkable.

findings.description: Structured claims extracted from the verbatim report. Extraction is lossy, so verbatim remains authoritative.

kind.description: A defect is something that does not work. A preference is dislike of something that works. Conflating them is the most common analysis error.

quote.description: The exact phrase, where the persona gave one

locus.description: Section, control, or element the finding attaches to

verified.description: Set by a reviewer who checked the claim against the artifact. A reported defect that turns out to be a silent gate is reclassified, not confirmed.

decisions.description: Choices the persona made while working, recorded so a later session can see how it behaved rather than only what it concluded.

gave_up.description: True where the persona abandoned a path. Abandonment is a finding.

unanswered.description: Questions this encounter raised and could not settle. Ask these up front next time, since a follow-up turn is not reliably available.

understood_purpose.description: Could the persona say what the thing does, in its own words

score.description: Only where the persona was asked for one. Do not synthesise a score.

run_id.description: The persona run (panel) this encounter belonged to. Lets a run resolve its encounters and a persona resolve every panel it sat on.
